datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: The Bijie landslide dataset is a publicly available dataset from Wuhan University in 2020 and contains a total of 770 landslide images and 2003 images without landslides (Ji et al. 2020).

methods.name: LD-YOLO
methods.summary: An improved YOLOv7-based model for landslide detection that incorporates the Efficient Channel Attention (ECA) mechanism into the backbone and head networks and replaces the original CIoU loss function with the Focal-EIoU loss function to improve detection accuracy for both old and new landslides.
methods.source: LIU Qing, WU Ting-ting, DENG Ya-hong, LIU Zhi-heng
methods.verbatim: In this study, we propose an improved deep learning model, landslide detection-you only look once (LD-YOLO), based on the existing you only look once (YOLO) model for the intelligent identification of old and new landslides in loess areas.
